{{Quote|Four worlds have been completely overrun. A fifth, Kaon, is down to a handful of survivors battling for their lives. Among those survivors are several nobles related to the ruling family. But we will have to act quickly if we want to rescue them.|[[Darth Nurin]]|<ref name="KUS" />}}
During the [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|Rakghoul outbreak]] in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]], caused by an exiled [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Sannus Lorrick]], both [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent strike teams on a '''mission''' to [[Kaon]] to investigate the situation.

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This article represents the events of the Flashpoint mission "Kaon Under Siege" in [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', available to both Imperial and Republic players. As such, it is not known which faction is canonically responsible for sending the strike team, so in the article it is assumed that they both did. The composition of the strike team does not alter events, though it is assumed that an Imperial strike team chooses the dark side option to kill [[Melarra]] at the end of the battle after the Republic strike team promised her a safe passage of the planet.<ref name="KUS" />
